sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "opening_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IDR', "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "planning_bucket" TEXT NULL, "expense_nature" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "transfer_to_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "transaction_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "recurring_instance_id" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'confirmed', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount > 0), CHECK ((type = 'transfer' AND transfer_to_account_id IS NOT NULL AND transfer_to_account_id <> account_id) OR (type <> 'transfer' AND transfer_to_account_id IS NULL AND category_id IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "local_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "image_hash" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "period_start" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_end" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attention_threshold" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 70, "warning_threshold" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 85, "over_threshold" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100, "last_notified_threshold" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("category_id", "period_start"), CHECK (amount > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "current_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "target_date" TEXT NULL, "monthly_target" INTEGER NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (target_amount > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES goals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "movement_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "movement_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount <> 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_rules" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval_days" INTEGER NULL, "day_of_month" INTEGER NULL, "day_of_week" INTEGER NULL, "month_of_year" INTEGER NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "reminder_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("reminder_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "reminder_offset_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reminder_time" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '09:00', "auto_confirm" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_confirm" IN (0, 1)), "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount > 0), CHECK (type IN ('income', 'expense')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_instances" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recurring_rule_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recurring_rules (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("recurring_rule_id", "due_date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_activity" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "checked_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "planning_settings" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "essential_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL, "family_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL, "emergency_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL, "savings_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL, "development_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL, "personal_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL, "flexible_residual_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("flexible_residual_mode" IN (0, 1)), "target_emergency_months" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, "emergency_lookback_months" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, "minimum_cash_buffer" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "user_reserve" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "merchant_mappings" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "raw_merchant" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "normalized_merchant" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "backups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "schema_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
